html: Purpose reset before first publication. The registry's purpose is stated: the open synthesis of the published evidence on instruments used to measure workplace health and wellbeing, scope the whole field by construct, the first 27 instruments stage one. Rubric v1.1: indirectness is defined by population type, never by country or language; every cell re-read, 92 flags changed and 6 grades moved (all upward, all occupational instruments), logged as correction C-0004 with the rubric 1.0 values kept on each cell. Schema 0.4: every indirectness flag carries its reason; relations on every record link single items and short forms to the multi-item instruments they were validated against, each citing its study; new single-item measures page. Freeze dated from first publication. Search venues and strings published on the methods page. No fresh literature search: as-of dates unchanged.
